examples.question_text:
Find each dot product.

(a) $\underset{\sim}{a}=\begin{pmatrix}4\\-3\end{pmatrix}$ and $\underset{\sim}{b}=\begin{pmatrix}-2\\5\end{pmatrix}$.

(b) $\underset{\sim}{u}=3\underset{\sim}{j}-\frac{5}{2}\underset{\sim}{i}$ and $\underset{\sim}{v}=4\underset{\sim}{i}-\frac{2}{3}\underset{\sim}{j}$.
examples.solution_text:
(a)
$\begin{aligned}\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}&=(4)(-2)+(-3)(5)\\&=-8-15\\&=-23\end{aligned}$

(b) Match the coefficients of $\underset{\sim}{i}$ and $\underset{\sim}{j}$, regardless of their written order.

$\begin{aligned}\underset{\sim}{u}\cdot\underset{\sim}{v}&=\left(-\frac{5}{2}\right)(4)+(3)\left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)\\&=-10-2\\&=-12\end{aligned}$

Each answer is a scalar.

examples.question_text: The points $A(-1,2)$, $B(3,5)$ and $C(5,-2)$ are given. Find $\overrightarrow{AB}\cdot\overrightarrow{AC}$.
examples.solution_text:
Subtract the starting coordinates from the finishing coordinates.

$\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{AB}&=\begin{pmatrix}3-(-1)\\5-2\end{pmatrix}\\&=\begin{pmatrix}4\\3\end{pmatrix}\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{AC}&=\begin{pmatrix}5-(-1)\\-2-2\end{pmatrix}\\&=\begin{pmatrix}6\\-4\end{pmatrix}\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{AB}\cdot\overrightarrow{AC}&=(4)(6)+(3)(-4)\\&=24-12\\&=12\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text: The vectors $\begin{pmatrix}x\\-\frac{3}{2}\end{pmatrix}$ and $\begin{pmatrix}-\frac{2}{3}\\4\end{pmatrix}$ have a dot product of $\frac{5}{3}$. Find $x$.
examples.solution_text:
Use the matching components to form an equation.

$\begin{aligned}x\left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)+\left(-\frac{3}{2}\right)(4)&=\frac{5}{3}\\-\frac{2}{3}x-6&=\frac{5}{3}\\-\frac{2}{3}x&=\frac{23}{3}\\x&=\frac{23}{3}\div\left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)\\x&=-\frac{23}{2}\end{aligned}$
